name: WavSlice
description: Generic tempo-synced 1-bar WAV slicer for NTS-3. Ships an original CC0 drum loop; drop your own WAV at assets/loop.wav or run make embed WAV=.... Hold the pad to run from the bar start on a step grid (tap position does not pick the start 16th). X = reverse chance. Y = slice grid (1/4, 1/8, 1/16, 1/32). STRT (Edit) offsets the walk origin.

params.name: STRT
params.detail: Which 16th of the bar the walk starts from (not pad X)

params.name: SIZE
params.detail: Slice length: 1/4, 1/8, 1/16, 1/32 of a bar, tempo-synced

params.name: TUNE
params.detail: Extra pitch around tempo-locked playback (±1 octave)

params.name: RPT
params.detail: RUN walks through slices. LOCK retriggers the start slice

params.name: HOLD
params.detail: GATE = hold to play. LATC keeps running after release
